1407.author: agent-ci-infra-bot[bot]
1407.body:
**Problem.** The English account page still read half-Chinese: token counts printed `1.2万`, ledger business types were hardcoded Chinese labels, and all number/credit/time formatters pinned `toLocaleString("zh-CN")`. The page also never subscribed to the language store.

**Changes**
- New `apps/desktop/src/views/account-format.ts`: number, credit and time formatters take the locale from `TEXT.languageTag`; token scale and business-type labels come from the dictionary (unknown `bizType` still falls back to the server value).
- `text/zh.ts` + `text/en.ts`: added `account.biz` (REGISTER, CHECKIN, BONUS, LLM_USAGE, ADMIN, REFUND) and `account.tokenCount` — 万 in Chinese (unchanged), K/M/B in English (`15K`, `24M`).
- `AccountPage.tsx` calls `useLanguage()` and passes `TEXT` to those helpers. `chinaDay`/`chinaDate` keep their internal `en-CA` comparison keys.

**Validation**
- `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop test`: 1507 tests, 1507 pass, 0 fail (7 new in `tests/account-format.test.tsx`).
- Reverting the helper module to the pre-fix code makes 5 of the 7 new cases fail (`15K` vs `1.5万`, `Sign-up bonus` vs `注册赠送`, en-US vs zh-CN dates, the English page printing `2396万`), so they distinguish the defect from the fix.
- `typecheck` clean (`Text` is `typeof ZH`, so both tables must key the same set); `pnpm build` builds every package.
- `pnpm ci:ut` could not run on this host: preflight `BUBBLEWRAP_UNAVAILABLE` (no `bwrap`, non-root), 0 of 8410 planned cases; the 7 new cases are in the frozen plan.
- `pnpm architecture:check`: 121/122, the failure an unrelated checkout-path test.

**Remaining risk.** No browser E2E covers the account ledger, so the switch is verified by static-render and live component tests rather than a browser run.

**Release.** `release:fix`: English UI shows English labels, K/M counts and locale dates; Chinese UI unchanged.

Closes #1394

```
pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop test
```

1408.author: agent-ci-infra-bot[bot]
1408.body:
The session column treated every timestamp under 24 hours old as "today", so a Session used yesterday at 22:00 and one used at 22:00 today both read `22:00`. Two identical clock-time branches also contradicted the function's comment.

## What changed
`stamp()` now compares local calendar dates, not elapsed hours. Same date keeps `HH:MM`; one day back reads `TEXT.workspace.yesterday`; 2–6 days use `daysAgo(n)`; 7+ use `weeksAgo(floor(n/7))`. Day indexes use local date components normalized to UTC, so DST cannot shift the count. The duplicated `days < 1` branch is gone.

The Issue assumed `昨天` existed, but it did not; because `Text = typeof ZH` requires parity, `workspace.yesterday` was added to both `zh.ts` and `en.ts`. The existing sidebar-extra date test was rewritten with deterministic calendar-day fixtures, with new cases for today, yesterday, day/week boundaries, invalid input, and the yesterday-22:00 render.

`SessionBar` is deliberately unchanged: it is outside this Issue's Sidebar scope, and its header describes the Session just opened, where the day is implicit. Its unconditional `HH:MM` is the same family of misreading, left as a possible follow-up.

## Validation
- `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop typecheck` — exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop test` — 1505 tests / 137 suites: 1505 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped.
- The old `stamp()` failed 4 new assertions, e.g. `expected '昨天', actual '22:00'`; all pass now.
- Rendered the real Sidebar/styles in Chromium (1000×700, DPR 2).

Before: `22:00`; after: `昨天`, `3天前`, `1周前`.
![Before](https://agent-ci-infra-bot.llmbots.co/pr-media/d5f97eeed475f90943601e2b789f3259847c8d8f2085fd2ab6a6b820c23f9c68)
![After](https://agent-ci-infra-bot.llmbots.co/pr-media/026e1fda7084655fefc05e01d8c2e17b64c5632ed6c76fb38eb20753ab9626cb)

## E2E user journeys
BLOCKED: no running stack or Playwright/bubblewrap setup here; the real Sidebar/styles were rendered in Chromium, but no full journey was run.

## Release
Release category: release:fix
User impact: yesterday's Sessions are distinguishable from today's.
Compatibility and migration: none.

Closes #1400

```

1409.author: agent-ci-infra-bot[bot]
1409.body:
Issue #1397: `readNumber()` collapsed empty and unparsable text into `undefined`; `maxTokens` became `null` ("no cap") and depth/nodes accepted `0` despite `min={1}`. Chromium reports `1e999` in `<input type=number>` as `value=""` with `validity.badInput=true`, so this revision treats that as refused, not empty.

## What changed
- Each field keeps its text and invalid flag. Empty with `badInput=false` is the only `null` path for `maxTokens`; anything else must be a finite safe integer >= 1, so `0`, negatives, fractions and `1e999` are refused; depth/nodes also refuse empty.
- A refused field keeps its text, sets `aria-invalid`, gets a red border, shows a `role="alert"` note and blocks Save (no PUT); correcting it clears the error.
- Fields use `onInput`, not `onChange`: React ignores the unchanged `""` after `badInput`, so clearing a refused field would otherwise not reach the component. `maxTokens` keeps `min={1}`; en/zh strings added; no API/schema change.

## Validation
- Desktop tests: 1505 pass / 0 fail / 0 skipped; typecheck: pass.
- `idea-tree-settings.test.tsx` (8 tests): original 3 pass / 5 fail; previous candidate 7 pass / 1 fail (the badInput case); final 8 pass.
- Real browser (Playwright/Chromium, component with stub client): 18/18 checks. `1e999` in Token limit -> `badInput=true`, `aria-invalid=true`, alert shown, Save disabled, 0 PUTs; clear -> Save enabled; 4096 -> PUT `maxTokens:4096`; empty -> PUT `maxTokens:null`; depth `0` refused, no PUT; depth `1e999` refused; depth `7` -> PUT `maxDepth:7`. Typed text stays visible.

## E2E user journeys
BLOCKED: `ci:ut`/`ci:st`/`ci:e2e` stop at `BUBBLEWRAP_UNAVAILABLE` (no bwrap, exit 127, not root). Planned/executed: UT 8403/0, ST 69/0, mocked E2E 193/0. No app journey ran; the harness covers the real component and browser events.

## Release
Release category: release:fix
User impact: invalid numbers are refused visibly instead of saved as "no cap" or 0.
Compatibility and migration: none.

Closes #1397

pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop test
```
